section: Red flags: 2026 audit office finding on public procurement rules

after: - The court held that the foundation, as a body governed by public law, is subject to the public contracts code, a status the foundation contests, and recommended that it apply the code in full, as it had for the contracts it reported to the court in 2024 and 2025, among them the renovation works on its building in Milan (Corte dei conti report on 2024).
reason: Determination 59/2026 (24 March 2026, sent 16 April 2026), the 174 staff, the MEF auditor's objection and the quoted sentence confirmed; the staff contract and procurement status are two issues, so two headings stay. The record cites this report only for its figures.
